entries.name: Vampirism+2

Hits on monsters have an 80% chance to recover HP and boost attack power.
Health increased is 1.70x that of Vampirism+1 (e.g 6 -> 10).

entries.name: Vampirism+1
entries.description:
Hits on monsters have a 60% chance to recover HP and boost attack power.
Increases attack power every time it activates up to +80 (amount of hits required depends on weapon type).
The attack power buff is reset upon being hit by large monsters. All hits and skills like Fencing+2 and Gunlance's heat blade can activate the skill.
Healing is based upon damage dealt, around 2-4% with a minimum of 1 hp restored. It also decreases proportionally with motion values, despite increasing with damage dealt.
DS, Tonfa, LBG: +3 (27x).
SnS, LS, GL, Lance, Swaxe, HBG, Bow: +4 (20x)
HH, Hammer: +5 (16x)
MS: +6 (14x)
GS: +7 (12x)

entries.name: Medical Sage

Instantly recover all red HP when using any healing item.

2 Players: Recovery items apply to the entire party.
3 Players: Recovery items apply to the entire party, +20 extra HP recovery.
4 Players: Recovery items apply to the entire party, +50 extra HP recovery.
※ Stacks with the Recovery skill, only pure recovery items are party wide (e.g Max Potions yes, Ancient Potions no).

entries.name: Status Pursuit

※ There is no effect on Raviente.

entries.name: Charge Attack Up+2
entries.description:
Further increases motion values for the following weapon actions:
Great Sword: Charged Slashes and Shining Sword
Long Sword: Ki Blade Release Slash, Puncture Slash and Running Charge
Hammer: All Charged Moves
Lance: Charged Poke
Tonfas: All Charged Moves
Switch Axe F: Upwards Slash (Heaven), Infinite Slashes (Heaven), Light Sword Charge Attack, Light Sword Infinite Slashes
Magnet Spike: Charged Triple Strike (Blunt Mode)
※ It should be noted that this skill does not increase the motion values by a set percentage or multiplier, differing per move of a weapon in its increased effectiveness.
Ex.: Shining Sword (GS) goes from 27MV to 47MV, having the biggest increase in the entire game with 1.74x. Other weapons and moves however get around 1.1x at most, with some as low as 1.04x

entries.description: Increases weapon drawing and sheathing speed by 20%. Does not stack with Master Seal or G Finesse weapon effects.

entries.name: Shiriagari
entries.description:
Increases attack power based on time elapsed in the quest.
1 min: +20, 3 min: +50, 5 min: +80, 10 min: +130, 15 min: +180, 20 min: +200.

entries.name: Adaptation+2
entries.description:
When HP is over 100, every attack checks all 3 types of damage and compares their values using a set multiplier (0.81x for melee or 0.72x for ranged) and if any of the multiplied damage types come out higher than the original damage type, the multiplied hitbox value will be used and the damage type will change to the one that works best.
If this skill is being triggered, there will be a purple effect similar to a critical hit. You can also cut tails with blunt weapons using this skill if it meets the criteria.

entries.name: Adaptation+1
entries.description:
When HP is over 100, every attack checks all 3 types of damage and compares their values using a set multiplier (0.72x for melee or 0.64x for ranged) and if any of the multiplied damage types come out higher than the original damage type, the multiplied hitbox value will be used and the damage type will change to the one that works best.
If this skill is being triggered, there will be a purple effect similar to a critical hit. You can also cut tails with blunt weapons using this skill if it meets the criteria.

entries.name: Combat Supremacy
entries.description:
Increases attack power by 1.2x while weapon is unsheathed. While unsheathed, stamina will rapidly decrease over time.
※ Even if stamina runs out, the effect will continue as long as the weapon is unsheathed.
※ Effect is nullified if Rasta is activated.

entries.name: Vigorous

entries.name: Consumption Slayer

Additional 0.2x multiplier on coatings at the cost of double consumption per shot. (no effect on bowguns).

entries.name: Obscurity
entries.description:
Increases attack power by a set value every time you block an attack, up to 10x. Values differ per weapon.
SnS, Lance, GL,Tonfa: 1-5 Blocked Attacks +40, 6-10 Blocked Attacks +20, Max Buff +300.
Switch Axe F, GS, MS: 1-5 Blocked Attacks +30, 6-10 Blocked Attacks +15, Max Buff +225.
LS: 1-5 Blocked Attacks +20, 6-10 Blocked Attacks +10, Max Buff +150.

entries.name: Rush
entries.description:
Successful attacks and guard actions gradually increase an invisible meter that has two stages.
Stage one: Increases attack power by 50 and a purple effect appears on the player. Stage two: Increases attack power by 130 and running with weapons costs 0 stamina.
The effect is completely reset when you use any items or sheathe your weapon.

entries.name: Ceaseless
entries.description:
Increases affinity and critical multiplier as you land attacks.
Disappears if you stop attacking for a number of seconds.
Reflect and Stylish Up count towards hit totals but Fencing+2 does not.
First phase: +35% affinity and +0.1x critical multiplier.
Second phase: +50% affinity and +0.15x critical multiplier.
Each weapon needs a different number of hits in order to move between phases.
Sns: 10s; 20 hits; 46 hits
DS: 11s; 16 hits; 38 hits
Tonfa: 11s; 15 hits; 36 hits
LBG: 11s; 36 hits; 98 hits
LS: 12s; 14 hits; 38 hits
Bow: 12s; 16 hits; 48 hits
MS: 12s; 11 hits; 30 hits
Lance, GL, Switch Axe F: 12; 13 hits; 36 hits
HBG: 13s; 28 hits; 76 hits
HH: 14s; 11 hits; 32 hits
GS: 15s; 7 hits; 21 hits
Hammer: 15s; 8 hits; 28 hits

entries.name: Point Breakthrough
entries.description:
Increases the physical hitzone value of a part that has been hit repeatedly by 5.
The effect has a time limit and is only applied to a single part at a time.
If a part has been afflicted by this effect before, it will have a lower resistance to it and it will be easier to apply it to that part again.
※ The hit build up works like status, meaning it decays and it's harder to activate if you hit it less consistently.
※ All parts build up the effect separately, and hitting different parts will not reset it.
※ The skill duration cannot be extended by hitting the afflicted part.
※ Big multi hit attacks like pierce shots and LS piercing stab require a bigger number of hits.
※ Only the user benefits from the effect.
※ Fencing +2 and GL heatblade lowers the hit requirement. Also, reflect counts for part buildup but stylish up doesn't.

entries.name: Furious
entries.description:
Increases attack power, affinity, element and status across 3 stages as you perform attacks, evasions or guards.
Stage 1: Increases attack power by 70, element by 1.05x, status by 1.05x and affinity by 10%.
Stage 2: Increases attack power by 100, element by 1.10x, status by 1.10x and affinity by 25%.
Stage 3: increases attack power by 180, element by 1.20x, status by 1.20x and affinity by 40%.
Taking a big hit from a monster lowers a stage. It is necessary to attack and evade/guard to progress stages.
Evades required to progress:
Lance, Hammer, GS, HH, LBG, HBG, Bow: 1/2/5
Swaxe F, LS, MS: 1/3/6
Tonfa,Sns: 2/3/7
DS: 2/3/7
Guards required to progress:
Lance, GL: 1/2/5
GS: 1/3/6
Swaxe F, LS, MS: 1/3/6
Tonfa, Sns: 1/2/5
※ You can progress faster with perfect guards.

entries.name: Thunder Clad
entries.description:
Gauge is accumulated by evading, attacking, and moving.
When the gauge is filled, Status Immunity, Movement Speed Up+2, Weapon Handling, and Evade distance up will be activated, and you get a +5 physical hitzone value bonus on every hit.
However, if a skill of the same system is activated, the skill with the highest effect takes precedence.
※ Any hit that launches you up immediately empties your gauge, including from other players.
※ The physical hitzone bonus stacks with Solid Determination and Exploit Weakness.

entries.name: Solid Determination
entries.description:
Increases attack power by 100, affinity by 100% and crit multiplier +0.25.
Grants the effects of Adrenaline+2 and Sharpness+1, as well as Exploit Weakness and Elemental Exploiter without hitzone value requirements.
Gunners get +5 hitzone values if they are within critical distance.
Does not stack with Attack, Strong Attack, Issen, Exploit Weakness, Elemental Exploiter, Precision, Critical Shot or Expert.
If skills of the same type are activated, the skill with the highest effect takes precedence.
Absolute Defense, True Guts, Great Guts and Guts are disabled
as well as Guts Tickets, Mega Guts Tickets and Soul Revival.

entries.name: Red Soul
entries.description:
Increases attack power by 15. Hitting another player will increase their attack power by 30.
※ Hitting a player who is under the effect of Blue Soul.
※ When hit by a player who has the Blue Soul skill you will be able to KO monsters with any weapon when hitting their head and your attack power increases by 30. All effects last 2 minutes.
※ Attack power is a final addition that is always the stated value and completely unaffected by other skills and multipliers.

entries.name: Blue Soul
entries.description:
Increases defense by 50. Hitting another player will increase their defense by 100.
※ Hitting a player who is under the effect of Blue Soul while he/she is under any status ailment in the game will dispel the effect.
※ Getting hit by a player who has the Red Soul skill active will increase your defense by 100 and grant the effect of Goddess' Embrace .
All effects last 2 minutes.

entries.name: Assistance
entries.description:
The player's arm will glow red and increase attack power by 20 and defense by 50, as well as grant the effects of Damage Recovery Speed+2, Status Immunity and Peerless to nearby Hunters.
Effective radius is 3 rolls or 2 with Evade Distance Up. Affected players have their arms glow yellow.
※ The player with the skill gets +20 attack power and +50 defense but does not benefit from Peerless, Status Immunity or Damage Recovery Speed.
※ The skills overwrite lower tier versions if any affected hunters have them. For example a hunter with Status Halved would gain Status Immunity within radius while a hunter with Status
Immunity (Myriad) would retain their version of the skill.
※ Attack is a final addition that is always the stated value and completely unaffected by other skills and multipliers.

entries.name: Grace+2
entries.description: If there are 2 or less active skills, grant the effects of Attack Up (Absolute), Issen+3, High-Grade Earplugs, Wind Res (Large), Quake Res+1, Evasion+1, Guard+1, Goddess' Embrace and Weapon Handling.

entries.name: Dark Finale
entries.description:
Upon health dropping to 0, you will rise again, gaining full Health and Stamina bars and Heavy Buffs but will also start constantly losing health at a steady rate.
Health loss cannot be halted by any methods and you will cart after exactly one minute has passed. Although the health degeneration cannot be stopped by any standard method, completing a quest will disable health loss meaning any final carts will not occur.
In your risen form you are granted the effects of the following: Adrenaline+2, Starving Wolf+2, Defense+120, Sharpening Artisan, Super HG Earplugs, Violent Wind Breaker, Quake Res+2, Heat Cancel and Cold Cancel.
Alongside these skills you will gain a Super Armor effect that grants immunity to all forms of knockback.

entries.name: Drawing Arts+1

While weapon is sheathed grant the effects of Damage Recovery Speed+1 and Quick Stamina Recovery (Small).

entries.name: Ice Age
entries.description:
Upon attacking a monster the hunter is surrounded by an icy aura. This aura deals damage to all monsters in its area and grants a number of different skills. This aura has three stages and will progress with more hits.
The aura also grants Stamina Recovery Up and Razor Sharp to all hunters affected by the aura and the one with the skill also gets Winter General.
Damage is dealt once every second fixed rather than over time.
Stage 1: (0.042 x True Raw x DefRate) DPS, 11-18s duration. 7s when downgraded to.
Stage 2: (0.098 x True Raw x DefRate) DPS, 14-25s duration. 10s when downgraded to.
Stage 3: (0.14 x True Raw x DefRate) DPS, 6-9s duration.

Works with Abnormality.

entries.name: Adaptation Up+2
entries.description: Increases Adaptation by 2 levels. Going beyond Adaptation+2 increases the Adaptation multipliers for Blademaster (from 0.81x) to 0.9x and 0.81x (from 0.72x) for Gunner.

entries.name: Adaptation Up+1
entries.description: Increases Adaptation by 1 level. Going beyond Adaptation+2 increases the Adaptation multipliers for Blademaster (from 0.81x) to 0.9x and 0.81x (from 0.72x) for Gunner.

entries.name: Reflect Up+3
entries.description: Increases Reflect by 3 levels. Going beyond Reflect+3 increases the MV of Reflect from 48 to 68 and Perfect Guard reflects from 72 to 92.

entries.name: Reflect Up+2
entries.description: Increases Reflect by 2 levels. Going beyond Reflect+3 increases the MV of Reflect from 48 to 68 and Perfect Guard reflects from 72 to 92.

entries.name: Reflect Up+1
entries.description: Increases Reflect by 1 level. Going beyond Reflect+3 increases the MV of reflect from 48 to 68 and Perfect Guard reflects from 72 to 92.

entries.name: Stylish Up
entries.description:
Successful evasion now also causes no sharpness loss for a fixed amount of hits depending on weapontype, as well as dealing a 30 MV attack to all nearby monsters.
※ Hits until sharpness decreases again: (Affected by Consumption Slayer)
DS: 5 Hits.
SnS & Tonfas: 4 Hits.
LS, Lance, SAF & MS: 3 Hits.
GS, Hammer, HH & GL: 2 Hits.
※ With Consumption Slayer SnS and DS get 2 hits and the rest gets 1.

entries.name: Vigorous Up
entries.description: Adds 100 Attack for Blademaster and 50 Attack for Gunner on top of Vigorous if your HP bar is completely filled.

entries.name: Obscurity Up
entries.description:
Reduces required block count to reach the maximum buff from 10 to 6. Recovers sharpness when blocking at the maximum buff. Perfect Guarding increases the block count by 3 and recovers more sharpness at max buff (e.g. 2 perfect guards = max buff).
※ The Attack buffs remain the same.
※ Blocking at max buff with Gunlance in Heat Blade mode reduces the sharpness loss upon expiration of Heat Blade.

entries.name: Soul Up
entries.description:
Red Soul: Grants 100 Attack to the user and player struck. Additionally stops stamina consumption while running unsheathed for the player struck.
Blue Soul: Grants 200 defense to the user and player struck. Additionally grants health recovery effects and removal of abnormal status effects (excluding Extreme statuses) for the player struck.
※ Works with Blazing Grace.
※ Attacks will no longer stagger other players.

entries.name: Rush Up
entries.description:
Adds a third stage to Rush. Grants 70 extra True Raw (total of 200) and stops stamina from decreasing during its duration.
※ The third stage strictly lasts for 30 seconds. After this it will need to be reactivated again.

entries.name: Ceaseless Up
entries.description:
Adds a third stage to Ceaseless and requires less hits to reach each stage.
First stage: +35% Affinity, +0.1x Critical Multiplier.
Second stage: +50% Affinity, +0.15x Critical Multiplier.
Third stage: +60% Affinity, +0.2x Critical Multiplier.
※ You now only go down by one stage upon timing out.
※ Reflect and Stylish Up count towards the hits but Fencing+2 does not.
